c. 1897, May
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK No. 9
Pg. 9 IN DIEM VIVAM in Novitiate
"If you desire to love crosses, learn first to forego unnecessary pleasures." - reasonable & natural !
"Willingly to serv God must be happiness" 5/23/97 "In omnibus rebus amor Domini" Pent. '97
Quid me ipso: quid non, Deo adiuvante?" 6/11/97
Dryness a humiliation & punishment 197
Pg. 10 "False humility trouble & the sadness we feel at sight of our sins are among the most subtle of the devil's snares," Humility & sorrow which comes from God, consoles and pacifies the soul. St. Teresa
"One of the best means to continue in the prac- tice of those good purposes we make in prayer is that we recolect the reason which had in- fluenced us to form them; because that which ocasioned the 1st thought will afterwards help us to conserve & practice it."
St. Austin
"O Lord, if Thou art pleased to bestow thy gifts upon me be thou the guardian thereof thyself, for I have a diffidence in myself and I am a great robber who may prove bankrupt to Thee." St. Francis
"God chose a life of suffering. - The Way the Truth & the Life."
